---
title: "About"
---

This site documents the container packaging for
[graywolf](https://github.com/chrissnell/graywolf), the APRS software by
Chris Snell. The container files and these docs live in the
`graywolf-container` repository; graywolf itself is developed upstream.

- [Home](index.qmd): background and overview
- [Building and running](usage.qmd): build, run, and Digirig setup
